records.text: Stacey Sheridan, Michael McCoy, and Elizabeth McCoy are at Charlie and Erika Kirk's apartment complex every day and work in its community center.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep DEtFh2Ff-58)

appearances.snippet: Yeah, she does, and I find it to be very weird and very creepy. Mikey (Michael McCoy)—I don't know if he has a place in there, he and Elizabeth—but they are there all the time, because I have sources that live in the building. Obviously, every single day they are there, and they are working. They all work ... work in like the community center there

verification.notes: This claim is attributed to unnamed apartment residents and concerns private daily movements and workplace activity. Live searches found no independent property, employment, access, or eyewitness records confirming all three people at the complex every day.
